headline: Stealth's ox-alpha hits 33.2% — day 2 of dominance
summary: Stealth's ox-alpha extended its all-time token-share record to 33.2%, up 0.9 percentage points in a day. DeepSeek slipped to rank 2 after a week of losses, while three new models entered the top 50: Meta's Muse Spark, DeepSeek's vision experiment, and OpenAI's text-embedding-3-small.
highlights: stealth/ox-alpha holds 33.2% token share — day 2 of record streak
DeepSeek provider share at 18.1%, down 7.6% over 7 days despite three models in top 20
Google gained 0.5% today but down 4.9% weekly; Xiaomi up 3.4% weekly to 9.5%
